verdict.rationale: Postman documents a public Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and integrating with toolchains and CI/CD, including an Analytics API (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-27, postman-docs-41, postman-docs-54). A probe also found a machine-readable OpenAPI document on the docs site. Missing for 10: detail on endpoint coverage, authentication, and rate limits; clear confirmation that the probed openapi.json describes the Postman API itself; and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
